catalog.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas of ten hanging Vietnamese garments for a dress-up game clothing picker.
Reference image: assets/references/studio/phongphoido.png. Match precisely the rich crisp pixel-art hanging dresses in the six clothing cards along its bottom. Generate ONLY the garments, no UI.
Composition: exactly FIVE columns and TWO rows, ten equal rectangular cells on a 5:3 overall canvas. One front-facing garment on a small wooden hanger centred in each cell, evenly aligned, entirely inside its cell with generous transparent gaps. No bodies, no heads, no mannequins, no trousers underneath, no paper cards or frames. Every garment tall and large in its cell, finely drawn, full-length hem.
Reading order row 1: (1) traditional Vietnamese four-panel ao tu than, open front with inner bib and sash, long sleeves; (2) five-panel ao ngu than tay chen with fitted narrow sleeves, tall standing collar and five small fasteners; (3) five-panel ao ngu than tay thung / ao tac with very wide ceremonial sleeves; (4) 1930s Le Mur ao dai with rounded puff shoulders, fitted waist; (5) 1930s yellow silk modern ao dai, fitted flowing long panels.
Row 2: (6) ivory wedding ao dai in plain homespun cotton; (7) modern ao dai with boat neckline; (8) fitted raglan-sleeve ao dai with standing collar; (9) neat student ao dai in poplin, simple and restrained; (10) contemporary remix five-panel garment with fitted sleeves.
All ten use GRAYSCALE cloth ONLY, soft ivory / light grey highlight through grey folds to charcoal outlines. Floral embroidery on hems and sleeves in silver-grey, similar to lotus blossom decoration in reference. Wooden hangers brown/gold. The neutral cloth will be recoloured by the game, so no coloured fabric. Keep exquisite pixel shading and crisp dark outlines matching reference. Actual transparent background, no words, no labels, no swatches, no watermark.

mirror.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: freestanding full-length mirror frame for the live dressing-room game.
Input image 1 reference: phongphoido.png. Recreate just the tall carved wooden mirror seen behind the central character, preserving its ornate reddish burgundy wood, muted golden edge highlights, lotus/flower carving at crown, narrow upright arched top, thick side posts, lower carved horizontal rail and two feet. Pixel-art matching the reference exactly.
Render the mirror front-on, centred, alone, full frame visible and no other objects. The entire interior glass opening must be genuinely TRANSPARENT (alpha zero), as must the exterior around the frame. Do not draw glass, scenery, tint, reflections, people, characters, letters or any contents in the opening. A game will render a live character inside it. Keep the aperture large (approximately x=17% to 83%, y=14% to 86%). Aspect ratio approximately 1:2.2. High quality crisp detailed game sprite, warm carved wood.
